ask: What should Bolta run for us? We're a 3-person physio clinic and want more bookings.
before: The look was done: the brand record exists, LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook are connected, one routine (Weekly tips, 3 a week) is on.

steps.why: What already waits for a yes: 12 drafts, most from Weekly tips. Count them before adding anything.

arguments.goals: More bookings for our physio clinic
arguments.context: 3-person physio clinic. Patients are mostly desk workers with back and neck pain and runners. They book online.

steps.why: Bolta sizes the set to review_load: here 12 waiting and 10 decided in two weeks, level medium, so at most 3 plans of at most 3 drafts a run, none repeating Weekly tips. At high (25+ waiting, or 10+ waiting and decisions far behind) it would be 2 plans of 2. Each plan has its own id and a why.

say:
You have 12 drafts waiting, so I've kept this small:
1. Patient wins: 2 Instagram and Facebook posts every Thursday about a real recovery you share (only with the patient's yes).
2. A monthly article on desk posture for your site, which you publish.
3. A weekly numbers report every Monday: posts nothing, no review.
Every draft waits for your yes. Which should I set up? They're saved switched off; nothing runs until you say so.
never: Recommending more drafts a week while 10+ wait undecided.
A second weekly-tips routine on the same networks.
